fragment.choose:
<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model-id", String.Empty) == "non-llm-request")">
            
        
        
            
            
                
                <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("api-type", String.Empty).Equals("openai-v1", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))">
                    <set-variable name="finalPath" value="@{
                        var basePath = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("api-base-path", "/openai");
                        return $"{basePath}/chat/completions";
                    }" />
                    @(context.Request.Body.As())
                

                
                <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("api-type", String.Empty).StartsWith("responses", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))">
                    <set-variable name="finalPath" value="@{
                        var apiType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("api-type", String.Empty);
                        var basePath = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("api-base-path", "/openai/responses");
                        var responseId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("response-id", String.Empty);
                        var method = context.Request.Method;

                        var includeResponseId = !String.IsNullOrEmpty(responseId) && (method == "GET" || method == "DELETE");
                        return includeResponseId ? $"{basePath}/{responseId}" : basePath;
                    }" />
                    
                    
                        <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("api-type", String.Empty) == "responses")">
                            
                                @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-api-version"))
                            
                        
                    
                

                
                <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("api-type", String.Empty).Equals("inference", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))">
                    <set-variable name="finalPath" value="@{
                        var poolType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("targetPoolType", "azure-openai");
                        var modelId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model-id", String.Empty);

                        // AI Foundry uses /models/ path
                        if (poolType == "ai-foundry") {
                            return "/models/chat/completions";
                        }

                        // Azure OpenAI uses /openai/deployments/{model}/ path
                        return $"/openai/deployments/{modelId}/chat/completions";
                    }" />
                    
                        @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-api-version"))
                    
                

                
                
                    <set-variable name="finalPath" value="@{
                        var poolType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("targetPoolType", "azure-openai");
                        var modelId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model-id", String.Empty);

                        // AI Foundry: use /models/ path
                        if (poolType == "ai-foundry") {
                            return "/models/chat/completions";
                        }

                        // Azure OpenAI: use /openai/deployments/{model}/ path
                        return $"/openai/deployments/{modelId}/chat/completions";
                    }" />
                    
                    @{
                        var body = context.Request.Body.As();
                        if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(body)) {
                            try {
                                var parsedBody = JObject.Parse(body);
                                var modelId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model-id", String.Empty);
                                if (parsedBody["model"] == null || String.IsNullOrEmpty(parsedBody["model"].ToString())) {
                                    parsedBody["model"] = modelId;
                                }
                                return parsedBody.ToString();
                            } catch {
                                return body;
                            }
                        }
                        return body;
                    }
                    
                        @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-api-version"))
                    
                
            

            
            
                <when condition="@(String.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("finalPath", String.Empty)))">
                    
                        @($"UAIG - Path builder error for API type: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("api-type")}, pool type: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("targetPoolType")}")
                    
                    
                        
                        
                            application/json
                        
                        @{
                            return new JObject(
                                new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                    new JProperty("message", $"No path determined for API type: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("api-type")}"),
                                    new JProperty("code", "path_builder_error")
                                ))
                            ).ToString();
                        }
                    
                
            

            
            <rewrite-uri template="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("finalPath"))" copy-unmatched-params="true" />
